project_name: Anil Sales Corporation - Inventory & POS SaaS
archetype: Jewel & Luxury mixed with Swiss & High-Contrast (Dark Default)

design_philosophy.vibe: Premium, Modern, Sexy SaaS-style UI with glassmorphism/subtle gradients, smooth animations, excellent typography, luxury feel
design_philosophy.inspiration: Linear × Vercel × Notion tailored for an Indian B2B retail context.
core_principles: Use deep Obsidian/Void black for base, with Jade (Emerald) and Cobalt accents. NEVER use the forbidden #1B93A4 teal.
Generous whitespace, premium bento-box layouts, and card-based structure.
High-contrast text against dark backgrounds using APCA standards.
Use 'Outfit' for highly structured, modern headings and 'Manrope' for crisp, legible tabular/body data.

color_palette.description: HSL values for Shadcn UI CSS variables. Base is deep Obsidian (#050505) with 1px glassmorphic borders and Emerald/Cobalt glowing accents.

spacing_and_layout.dashboard: Bento-grid protocol. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. KPI cards (col-span-1). Main Recharts area (col-span-3). Dense but extremely readable padding (p-6 inside cards).
spacing_and_layout.pos_page: Split layout. Left side (2/3 width) for quick search and product grid with stock badges. Right side (1/3 width) sticky cart containing line items, customer picker, payment method tabs, and checkout total. Height of cart should be h-[calc(100vh-theme(spacing.24))] sticky at top-24.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: Collapsible Sidebar Nav (Dashboard, POS, Products, Customers, Orders, Analytics, Settings). Dark glass background: bg-background/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-r border-border.
spacing_and_layout.topbar: Global search, dark/light toggle, notifications, user avatar. Sticky top-0 z-50 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border h-16 px-6 flex items-center justify-between.

component_styles.buttons: Shadcn buttons with slight hover lift (-translate-y-[1px]) and shadow-lg. Primary button uses Jade Emerald.
component_styles.cards: Cardless/Subtle roundness approach for data (8px radius max). 1px solid border-border. Hover: slight border color lightening.
component_styles.inputs_and_forms: Solid dark inputs (bg-white/5), 1px border. Focus states MUST have higher contrast ring (ring-2 ring-primary).
component_styles.badges: For stock status. Low Stock (Red/Destructive bg-destructive/20 text-destructive-foreground). In Stock (Emerald bg-primary/20 text-primary).
component_styles.modals_drawers: Use glassmorphic overlay (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm). Drawer for stock adjustments and customer history. Modals for Invoice Preview.
component_styles.tables: Shadcn Tables. Header text small, uppercase, tracking-wider (text-muted-foreground). Row hover effect: bg-muted/50.

key_features_and_data_testid.dashboard: Recharts sales trend line, KPI cards, low stock alerts. data-testid='dashboard-kpi-revenue'
key_features_and_data_testid.pos: Fast product search, customer lookup, discounts, multiple payment tabs (Cash/UPI/Bank/Cheque/Credit). data-testid='pos-search-input', data-testid='pos-add-to-cart-btn', data-testid='pos-checkout-btn'
key_features_and_data_testid.invoice: Invoice preview modal (ASC-YYYYMMDDHHMMSS) with branding, print/PDF download. data-testid='invoice-print-btn'
key_features_and_data_testid.products: CRUD, search/filter, low stock badges, stock-adjust drawer. data-testid='product-add-btn', data-testid='product-table-row'
key_features_and_data_testid.customers: Table with credit limit, balance pills, purchase history drawer. data-testid='customer-balance-badge'
key_features_and_data_testid.orders: Pending -> Dispatched -> Completed status pills. data-testid='order-status-pill'
key_features_and_data_testid.analytics: Recharts: revenue trend area, top products bar, category donut, payment method stacked bar. data-testid='analytics-revenue-chart'

empty_states_and_backgrounds.description: Abstract dark background with wisps of smoke (Use for Login page background)
Golden metallic lines against black (Alternative hero/login background)

placeholder_products_for_pos.description: Close-up of a modern bathtub faucet
Modern bathroom sink with accessories on wooden counter
Modern black oval sink with marble wall and countertop

media.icons_strategy: Use lucide-react for all standard icons (Dashboard, User, Search, Settings, Cart, CreditCard, Banknote, FileText). Size 18px to 20px, stroke-width 1.5 or 2 for a crisp, technical look.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace index.css variables with the HSL values provided in this JSON.
2. Inject Google Fonts (@import) at the top of index.css and update tailwind.config.js to extend 'outfit' and 'manrope' font families.
3. Implement the POS page with the split 2/3 and 1/3 layout, ensuring the right cart is sticky.
4. Use Recharts for the Dashboard and Analytics sections. Ensure line/area charts have proper dark mode stroke/fill colors using the CSS variables (e.g., hsl(var(--primary))).
5. For the invoice generator, strictly format the invoice number as 'ASC-YYYYMMDDHHMMSS' and make the modal look like a printable A4 sheet.
6. Build the bento grid dashboard layout prioritizing density and scanning ease (Swiss/High-contrast structural rules).
7. Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements as requested in testing guidelines.
8. Ensure glassmorphism is achieved using bg-background/60 backdrop-blur-xl and 1px border where specified.
